Good, confirmed hierarchy is fully covered: `JsonNode` (abstract decl) → `ContainerNode` (abstract redeclare) → `ArrayNode`, `ObjectNode` (concrete overrides) and `ValueNode` (final override, inherited by all value node subclasses including `MissingNode`, so no separate site needed there).

No other production call sites invoke `JsonNode.get(int)` directly — all other `.get(...)` calls found are on `List`/`Map`/`AtomicLong` etc., not on a `JsonNode` receiver.
